testcase.name: the written file's content is exactly what GpxCodec encode produces for this track
exporting the same track twice overwrites the same file rather than creating a second one
before it writes, an export deletes the exports more than an hour old and keeps the ones within the hour
the filename is derived from the track's own start time, not the export time
write creates the export directory if it does not exist yet, and returns a file that exists
waypoints handed to write reach the file, same as GpxCodec encode would produce
